The Street’s Key Stock Analysts Research Reports
$ADUS, $AJRD, $AAPL, $ADP, $BRX, $EMR, $DAVA, $FN, $FG, $HON, $ITW, $IR
Daily HeffX -LTN reviews dozens of the Street’s Key analysts research reports to ID new trading and investing ideas for HeffX -LTN readers. Some reports cover stocks to buy , and others cover stocks to sell or avoid.
Below is a list of the Street’s Key analysts outlook for main issues for Wednesday, as follows:
Addus Homecare Corp. (NASDAQ:ADUS) analysts started with a Buy rating and assigned a 75 price target at Jeffries & Company
Aerojet Rocketdyne Holdings Inc. (NYSE:AJRD) was reiterated as Buy and the price target was raised to 41 from 36 at SunTrust Robinson Humphrey.
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) analysts reiterated as Buy and the price objective was raised to 250 from 230 at Merrill Lynch.
Automatic Data Processing Inc. (NASDAQ:ADP) analysts started with a Buy rating and assigned a 175 price target at Guggenheim.
Brixmore Property Group Inc. (NYSE:BRX) was downgraded to Neutral from Buy at Mizuho.
Emerson Electric Co. (NYSE:EMR) was started with an Overweight rating and assigned an 85 price target at Morgan Stanley.
Endava PLC (NYSE:DAVA) started as Outperform at William Blair and also as at Cowen. Credit Suisse started it with an Outperform rating too and assigned a 27 price target.
Fabrinet (NYSE:FN) was downgraded to Buy from Strong Buy with a 55 price target at Needham. Shares finished at 46.75 Tuesday.
FGL Holdings (NYSE:FG) was started as Neutral at Goldman Sachs.
Honeywell International Inc. (NYSE:HON) was started with an Overweight rating and assigned a 175 price target at Morgan Stanley.
Illinois Tool Works (NYSE:ITW) was started with a Neutral rating and assigned a 146 price target at Morgan Stanley.
Ingersol-Rand PLC (NYSE:IR) was started with an Overweight rating and assigned a 111 price target at Morgan Stanley.
Stay tuned…
